## Review and execution limits

The initial source-ready packet is historical preparation data. A fresh composition-review record must bind the completed independent reviews and all thirteen final input hashes before execution. The publisher correction must also have its own completed review. The enabled review fields alone grant no execution or acceptance authority. All sixteen native controls remain pending, the production registry remains closed, and this preparation creates no admission or root authority. The protected OS bootstrap, actual systemd/cgroup joins and genuine C# custody remain prerequisites to any future native result. Old failed attempts remain historical evidence; neither first-fault diagnostics nor root-tool settlement can upgrade them.
